searchText: Looks like they are only validation tests, are there tests for the functionality as well? https://github.com/ethereum/tests/tree/develop/EIPTests - not full coverage. We are in pause waiting for the EF testing team to put some EOF structures in place so we can finish the testing in execution-spec-tests Blockchain tests may fail for things unrelated to EOF if you have implemented items like deposits. This https://github.com/ethereum/tests/tree/develop/EIPTests/StateTests and also this https://github.com/ethereum/tests/pull/1324 Full list of tests in https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/blob/main/spec/implementation_matrix.md Here are some basic DATA* tests - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/518
